reward_model_selection: minimum validation multiclass log loss; retain fit on 80 percent training subset
shrinkage_selection: per candidate, n, gamma: minimum exact validation-pool MSE of paired advantage; frozen before test outcomes; this is our tuning rule, not Su et al. model selection
success_axes: minimize probability of negative true advantage
maximize mean true advantage including zero on fallback
success_rule: Report every cell. Primary contrast is corrected versus nominal centered DR/Bernstein; fitted DR/Bernstein is a secondary matched contrast. Assess both harm and mean true improvement under adaptive attack, and clean improvement cost. A useful defense must reduce harm while retaining positive utility; report fallback and unresolved adversarial utility/harm separately. Finite comparisons cannot prove Pareto optimality.
threat: White-box reward-only edits, at most floor(n*epsilon) rows, arbitrary replacement in [0,1]. Policies, reward model, contexts, actions and propensities trusted and frozen. Search uses binary flips; deterministic envelopes cover real-valued replacements. Oracle attacker knows true candidate ordering; defender does not.
confidence: Label-free Bernstein second-moment and range bounds over the known uniform finite context pool. No test labels used for confidence terms. Union bound over six candidates per gate. Point-estimate gates have no statistical guarantee.

attack.method: universal score envelopes; targeted top-k witnesses; adaptive active-branch MILP with competitor cutting planes; validate actual final gate
attack.incomplete_search: retain unresolved interval; never label failed search robust

scope: E3 benchmark-design stress test; all E2 estimators, confidence allowances, attack budgets, sample sizes, exploration levels and alpha retained. New log seeds. No claim of independent benchmark discovery: E2 test results were previously inspected.
ethics: Local copies of public attributed data only; no external deployed system attacked.

policy_construction.incumbent: full-feature multinomial logistic regression C=0.1; unchanged from E2
weak_parents: top four image rows only, C=1
bottom four image rows only, C=1
policy_construction.mixture_rule: For each weak parent and target, mix it with the strong parent. The mixture weight is computed analytically from validation mean correct-class probability; clip to [0,1] if target cannot be bracketed, and report clipping. Retain all six candidates.
policy_construction.no_evaluation_feedback: Freeze mixture weights, scaler, all fitted coefficients and validation predictions in a separate command before reading evaluation labels. No library retries or candidate filtering based on evaluation values.
policy_construction.rationale: Small average gaps with disagreement across contexts, rather than scaling each E2 candidate difference towards zero.

outcome_definitions.utility: selected candidate true finite-pool advantage, zero on fallback
outcome_definitions.adaptive_harm_note: attacker minimizes true utility, not the average harm indicator; a harmful witness establishes vulnerability. No harmful witness does not establish safety unless harmful outcomes are excluded by certificates.

execution: Four processes; sixteen predeclared 25-seed shards for main; four 2-seed shards for timing. Timing seeds excluded from inference. Preserve failed/partial attempts if any.
